q: When Pashhur the priest heard Jeremiah prophesying in the house of the LORD, what did he do to Jeremiah?
a: He had him beaten and put in the stocks

q: Who put Jeremiah in the stocks at the Upper Gate of Benjamin?
Who was Pashhur, the man who put Jeremiah in the stocks?
a: A priest, the son of Immer

q: After Pashhur released Jeremiah from the stocks, what name did Jeremiah say the LORD called Pashhur?
According to Jeremiah, where would Pashhur and all who lived in his house be taken, and die?
What did Jeremiah say would happen to Pashhur and his family?
a: They would be taken captive to Babylon

q: What does Jeremiah say he proclaims whenever he speaks, in Jeremiah 20:8?
In Jeremiah 20:9, what does Jeremiah say happens when he tries not to mention the LORD or speak in His name any more?
a: His message becomes a fire burning in his heart

q: What do Jeremiah's trusted friends watch for, according to Jeremiah 20:10?
a: His fall, so they can prevail against him and take vengeance

q: In Jeremiah 20:11, how does Jeremiah describe the LORD's presence with him?
In Jeremiah 20:13, why does Jeremiah call on people to sing to the LORD and praise Him?
a: He rescues the life of the needy from the hands of evildoers
